# PlanetWatch.ai

> PlanetWatch.ai builds AI-powered biodiversity intelligence for renewable energy operators. Its computer-vision and deep-learning platform detects, classifies, and helps protect sensitive species — birds, bats, and migratory fish — around wind, solar, and hydropower installations, on land and at sea.

Site: https://planetwatch.ai/

## What it does

- Detects and classifies birds, bats, and migratory fish from up to 6 miles away, estimating abundance, population trends, and survival rates.
- Analyzes images, sound, and flight trajectories in real time to understand how energy installations affect local wildlife.
- Reduces collision mortality and unnecessary emergency turbine shutdowns through predictive, data-driven curtailment.
- Ships a patent-pending visual deterrent that integrates with SCADA to slow or stop turbines when a protected species is at risk.
- Runs on NVIDIA Jetson edge hardware, so detection works even at remote sites without reliable connectivity.

Reported figures: 99%+ detection accuracy, sub-1-second real-time response, 50+ species classified.

## Solutions by site type (https://planetwatch.ai/#solutions)

- Onshore Wind — autonomous 24/7 avifauna surveillance on edge computing, reducing collision risk and unnecessary curtailment.
- Offshore Wind — computer vision tuned for harsh, remote environments to monitor seabirds and marine life.
- Hydropower — tracks migratory fish trajectories near dams and intakes to inform safe-passage strategies.
- Solar & Mixed Sites — detects necrophagous and granivorous species drawn by agricultural activity near mixed-use sites.

## Traction (https://planetwatch.ai/#cases)

- 20+ PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) surveillance units deployed in the field, running fully on edge computing.
- An agricultural curtailment module that detects farming activity in real time near rural wind farms.
- A benchmark study comparing avian-detection AI algorithms at a wind farm in southern France.
- A black stork environmental study using trajectory analysis to map collision risk and optimize turbine placement.
- Strategic environmental partnership with Calidris.

## Market (https://planetwatch.ai/#investors)

- Global wind energy market projected at $543B by 2034, up from $174B in 2024.
- Bird detection system market projected at $250M by 2033 (7.77% CAGR).
